entries.en: to snatch the hair; to pull off (hair) by force
entries.notes: 西文cabello（头发）与汉字'綜来'不完全对应，'綜'疑为'鬃'之形误，据西文语义与音写定为强夺（头发）义。

entries.en: to snatch; to seize by force
to snatch the club or mallet; to seize a stick by force
entries.notes: 西文栏标[疑]难辨，仅可辨'palo curvo'（弯棍）字样，据汉字'夺槥'与音写定为夺槌棒之义。

entries.en: to snatch the belt or sash
entries.notes: 西文栏标[疑]难辨，据汉字'夺带'与音写tōa（带）定为夺带子之义。

entries.en: to snatch and bring away

entries.zh: 夺去拿走（末字难辨，释义存疑）
entries.en: to take away by force
entries.notes: 官话栏两音注记T99污损难辨，汉字末字'哪'与西文'mete'（放入）不合，仅'夺去'义可定，故降为低置信。

entries.en: to snatch and flee; to seize and run away
to rob by force; to plunder

entries.zh: 劫夺人的衣物；强剥人衣
entries.en: to rob a person of his clothes; to strip someone by force
to snatch; to plunder
to snatch and scatter, fleeing in all directions
entries.notes: 西文栏标[疑]难辨（疑为'y esparcen'，抢而散开），据汉字'四散'与音写sy soà定夺。

entries.en: to snatch and run away

entries.zh: 抢买便宜货；趁价贱抢购
entries.en: to snatch up goods by buying cheap; to grab a bargain

entries.en: a grabber of money; a rapacious extortioner (lit. 'money tiger')
entries.notes: 西文'vintige'标[疑]难辨；'抢钱虎'为喻称，据汉字与音写tshînn-hóu定为掠钱如虎之徒。

entries.en: a robbing thief; to snatch and steal
to abduct a woman for marriage; to seize a bride by force
entries.notes: 西文'aonsla'标[疑]难辨（疑为'a una muger'，对一妇人），与汉字'抢嫁'及音写kê（嫁）相应定为强抢成婚义。

to snatch and plunder
entries.notes: 西文栏标[疑]难辨，据汉字'抢剥'与音写pag（剥）定为抢夺劫剥之义。

entries.en: to seize; to occupy by force

to occupy a place or spot
entries.notes: 西文栏标[疑]难辨（疑承上条'夺其位'文例），据汉字'占处'与音写thé（处）定为占据处所义。

entries.en: to strip; to plunder
to plunder and despoil
entries.notes: 西文'nabatina'标[疑]难辨，据汉字'剥劫'与音写pag guiap定为劫掠义。
